account_page.title: Account
account_page.subtitle: Manage your account data and deletion settings.

export.title: Download your data
export.description: Request a copy of your personal data (GDPR Article 20 — right to data portability). The export includes your profile, linked accounts, and subscription history as a ZIP archive. You'll receive an email with the download link.
export.link_expiry: Download link expires 7 days after the export was generated.
export.preparing: Your export is being prepared. We'll email you when it's ready.
export.request_button: Request a copy of my data
export.included_profile: account info, email, phone, date of birth, preferences
export.rate_limit: One export request allowed every 30 days.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently delete your account. This begins a 30-day grace period — you can log back in and cancel at any time during that window. After 30 days your personal data is anonymised and cannot be recovered.
delete.deleted_item_1: Name, email address, phone number, date of birth
delete.kept_item_1: Subscription history — required for legal and financial records
delete.confirm_description: Your account will be permanently deleted after 30 days. You can cancel this within the 30-day window by logging back in.
delete.no_refund_notice: Your subscription will not be refunded.

account_verification.title: Account Verification
account_verification.email_sent_toast: A verification email has been sent to {{email}}.
account_verification.add_phone_first_toast: Please add a phone number in your profile settings first.
account_verification.sms_sent_toast: A verification SMS has been sent to {{phone}}.

notification_preferences_settings.title: Notifications
notification_preferences_settings.description: Choose how you want to be notified for each type of event.

marketing_settings.title: Marketing
marketing_settings.marketing_emails_description: Receive news, promotions, and personalised offers.
marketing_settings.error_toast: Failed to save preferences. Please try again.

privacy_settings.title: Privacy
privacy_settings.show_full_name: Show full name on my reviews
privacy_settings.show_full_name_description: Reviews you post are public. When off, we show your first name and last initial instead of your full last name.
privacy_settings.error_toast: Failed to save preferences. Please try again.

profile_tfa_settings.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
profile_tfa_settings.description: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. After entering your password, you'll be asked for a one-time code generated by an authenticator app (like Google Authenticator). This ensures that only you can access your account, even if someone else knows your password.
profile_tfa_settings.backup_codes_downloaded: New backup codes downloaded. Old codes are now invalid.
profile_tfa_settings.save_backup_codes_description: These are your 2FA recovery codes. Store them somewhere safe.
profile_tfa_settings.codes_not_shown_again: These codes won't be shown again. Save them now.
profile_tfa_settings.regenerate_confirm_description: This will invalidate your existing backup codes. A new set will be downloaded as a PDF.
profile_tfa_settings.backup_codes_description: Download a fresh set of recovery codes. Your old codes will be invalidated.
profile_tfa_settings.regen_rate_limit_hint: You can regenerate backup codes once per hour
profile_tfa_settings.enable_2fa_description: Scan the QR code below with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.), then enter the 6-digit code it gives you to verify setup.
profile_tfa_settings.cant_scan: Can't scan? Enter this code manually
profile_tfa_settings.same_phone_hint: On the same phone as your authenticator app?

disable_tfa_notice.title: Two-Factor Authentication Enabled
disable_tfa_notice.description: Disabling 2FA will remove the extra layer of security on your account. You’ll only need your password to log in after this action.

danger_zone_settings.title: Danger Zone
danger_zone_settings.delete_account_description: Permanently delete your account. You have a 30-day window to cancel after requesting deletion.
danger_zone_settings.confirm_intro_prefix: Your account will be permanently deleted after
danger_zone_settings.confirm_intro_suffix: You can cancel this within the 30-day window by logging back in.
danger_zone_settings.no_refund: Your subscription will not be refunded.
